about_the_game:
Okey and 101 Finally on Steam!

The long-awaited game has arrived! Finally, play Okey and 101 with your Steam friends in the most appropriate way with the rules and penalties you are used to.

Must Have in Your Library!

You never know when you will play Okey and 101, one of the traditional games that everyone knows. At any moment, a friend may invite you to a match and want to compete, be ready.

Competitive Matches!

Take your place in the matches where you will compete with your opponents to reach the highest level in the competitive mode that we will add soon.

Buy Once, Play Unlimited and Unlimited!

Once you buy the game, you will not have to pay again to play. Play whenever you want, with the people you want or with online opponents at your level. There are no in-game pay-to-play or pay-to-win mechanisms here.
